name: ansi-tools
description: Align, fold, refill and print text by its visible width when it has ANSI colors or East Asian characters: ansicolumn (column -t that lines up colored and Japanese cells), ansifold (fold/fmt with word boundaries and Japanese line breaking, -r refills paragraphs), ansiprintf and ansiecho (printf and echo with color and screen-width fields), cat-v (show tabs and control characters)
